9.answer_sqlite:
select t2.id
from Weather as t1, Weather as t2
where date(t2.recordDate) = date(t1.recordDate, '+1 day')
  and t2.temperature > t1.temperature;

14.answer_sqlite:
select s.user_id,
  round(avg(case when c.action = 'confirmed' then 1 else 0 end), 2) as confirmation_rate
from Signups as s
left join Confirmations as c on s.user_id = c.user_id
group by s.user_id;

24.answer_sqlite:
select t.activity_date as day,
  count(distinct t.user_id) as active_users
from Activity as t
where t.activity_date > date('2019-07-27', '-30 day')
  and t.activity_date <= '2019-07-27'
group by t.activity_date;

40.answer_sqlite:
select a.visited_on, a.amount, round(a.amount / 7, 2) as average_amount
from (
  select t1.visited_on,
    (select sum(t2.amount) from Customer as t2
     where t2.visited_on <= t1.visited_on
       and t2.visited_on >= date(t1.visited_on, '-6 day')) as amount
  from Customer as t1
  where t1.visited_on >= date((select min(visited_on) from Customer), '+6 day')
  group by t1.visited_on
) as a
order by a.visited_on asc;

48.answer_sqlite:
select t.sell_date,
  count(distinct t.product) as num_sold,
  (select group_concat(p2.product, ',')
   from (select distinct product from Activities where sell_date = t.sell_date order by product) as p2) as products
from Activities as t
group by t.sell_date
order by t.sell_date asc;

49.answer_sqlite:
select p.product_name, sum(o.unit) as unit
from Products as p join Orders as o on p.product_id = o.product_id
where o.order_date like '2020-02%'
group by p.product_id, p.product_name
having sum(o.unit) >= 100;

select * from Users as t
where substr(t.mail, 1, 1) GLOB '[a-zA-Z]'
  and t.mail like '%@leetcode.com'
  and substr(t.mail, 1, length(t.mail) - 13) not GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]*'
  and instr(substr(t.mail, 1, length(t.mail) - 13), '@') = 0;
